findings.subject: research/tools/df_priority122_conflict_diagnostic.js
findings.detail: Fallback auditRows.find matches supplemental batch014 audit by inputItemID/outputItemID only. A synthetic supplemental audit explicitly marked inputQualityRank=1 for the same item IDs was attached as sourceClaimID corroboration for an inputQualityRank=2 target; diagnostic accepted all five targets and declared nonpromoting source audit successful.
findings.requestedRepair: When a supplemental audit explicitly declares input/output rank, reject rank disagreement before using its claim as corroboration. Require typed family/epoch/operation compatibility or label an unmatched audit as uncorroborated; never invent original source lines. Preserve original TSM units and all preview quarantine.

findings.detail: RAW_CURRENT_RETAIL observationEpoch 2026-02-29T20:00:00Z and 2026-02-30T20:00:00Z pass regex and Date.parse even though both dates are invalid in nonleap 2026.
findings.requestedRepair: Validate ISO calendar day exactly by round-trip, including leap-year and offset semantics; do not treat Date.parse normalization as exact timestamp validation.

findings.detail: capEvidenceID equal to sourceStudyFamilyID plus trailing whitespace passes the supposedly independent cap certificate check and yields a finite E upper interval.
findings.requestedRepair: Normalize/compare lineage identifiers before distinct-family check; an arbitrary different ID is still a caller assertion, not an independently verified certificate.

findings.detail: Two RAW-shaped synthetic cohorts with different patch, recipeSpellID, input/output ranks, professionSkill and Resourcefulness yield byte-identical result objects when sourceStudyFamilyID, input ID and event totals are the same. The typed input context is discarded from result provenance.
findings.requestedRepair: Include immutable typed context snapshot or deterministic context fingerprint in each output, and prevent cross-profile pooling/attestation collisions.
